mechanism: A returned declaration is corrected and resubmitted, or abandoned
measures: Share of 'returned to employee' events followed directly by a new submission, and the elapsed time between them
simulator_parameter: correction loop: chance a returned item is resubmitted, and time to resubmit

value.interval_95_meaning: Wilson interval for the resubmission share

conditions: Eindhoven University of Technology travel expense declarations (domestic), 2017 two departments, 2018 whole university; staff anonymised to roles
transfer: Analogue range for a quote returned to its drafter. Elapsed time includes other work.

source.name: BPI Challenge 2020: Domestic Declarations
source.creator: Boudewijn van Dongen, Eindhoven University of Technology
